_readme: Each entry's 'sources' list is what Stremio shows under 'streams'. Supported source fields: ytId (YouTube video id, plays in Stremio), url (direct mp4/m3u8 you are licensed to use), externalUrl (opens an official page in the browser). For series, add 'episodes' keyed 'season:episode' with their own sources. Only add sources from official/licensed uploaders (e.g. SABC, kykNET, rights-holder YouTube channels, SABC Plus).

series.name: 'Sgudi 'Snaysi
series.description: Zulu-language SABC sitcom set in a Soweto house, following unemployed lodger S'dumo (Joe Mafela). 78 half-hour episodes.

series.name: Orkney Snork Nie
series.description: Classic Afrikaans SABC sitcom about life in the town of Orkney.

series.name: Isidingo
series.description: SABC 3 soap opera set in the mining town of Horizon Deep.

movie.name: The Gods Must Be Crazy
movie.description: Jamie Uys's comedy about a Kalahari bushman and a Coca-Cola bottle.

movie.name: Mapantsula
movie.description: Oliver Schmitz's landmark anti-apartheid crime drama following petty thief Panic. Restored in 4K by Film Movement.

movie.name: Jock of the Bushveld
movie.description: Adventure film based on Sir Percy FitzPatrick's classic about a transport rider and his Staffordshire Bull Terrier.

movie.name: Oh Shucks! Here Comes UNTAG
movie.description: Jamie Uys's comedy set around the UN transition in Namibia.
